def _features(train, test):
    x = np.vstack([train['coupon_features_raw'], test['coupon_features_raw']])
    refs = np.vstack([train['ref_coupons'], test['ref_coupons']])
    labs = np.concatenate([train['lab_id'], test['lab_id']])
    strata = np.concatenate([train['stratum'], test['stratum']])
    for lab in np.unique(labs):
        i = labs == lab
        ref = refs[i]
        center = np.median(ref.mean(axis=0))
        scale = np.median(ref.std(axis=0, ddof=0))
        x[i] = (x[i] - center) / scale
    (_, cells, counts) = np.unique(np.column_stack([labs, strata]), axis=0, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    w = 1.0 / counts[cells, None]
    observed = np.isfinite(x)
    means = (w * np.where(observed, x, 0)).sum(axis=0) / (w * observed).sum(axis=0)
    x = np.where(observed, x, means)
    return (x[:len(train['lab_id'])], x[len(train['lab_id']):])

def _design(group, x, stress, dt, t, taus):
    past = stress[0] + group['past_channel_raw'] @ stress[1:]
    hold = stress[0] + group['hold_channel_raw'] @ stress[1:]
    age = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[::-1])[::-1][1:], 0.0]
    history_weights = -np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / taus) * np.exp(-age[:, None] / taus)
    gap = hold[:, None] - past @ history_weights
    drift = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(x)), x])
    curves = np.concatenate([gap[:, None, :] * -np.expm1(-t[None, :, None] / taus), drift[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None]], axis=2)
    rates = np.column_stack([gap / taus, drift])
    return (curves, rates)

def _fit(train, x, stress, dt, times):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    y_curve = train['strain_curves_obs'] - train['strain_0'][:, None]
    y_rate = train['instant_rate_obs']
    y = np.r_[y_curve.ravel(), y_rate]
    n = y_curve.size

    def design(taus):
        (c, r) = _design(train, x, stress, dt, times, taus)
        return np.vstack([c.reshape(-1, 7), r])

    def residual(p, scales):
        return (design(np.exp(p[:2])) @ p[2:] - y) / scales
    lower = np.r_[np.log([0.05000001] * 2), np.full(7, -np.inf)]
    upper = np.r_[np.log([24.999999] * 2), np.full(7, np.inf)]
    starts = [(0.28, 2.2), (0.11, 1.1), (0.65, 5.6), (1.2, 13.0)]
    candidates = []
    for taus in starts:
        theta = np.linalg.lstsq(design(np.array(taus)), y, rcond=None)[0]
        fit = least_squares(residual, np.r_[np.log(taus), theta], args=(1.0,), bounds=(lower, upper), loss='soft_l1', f_scale=0.035, x_scale='jac', max_nfev=160)
        candidates.append(fit)
    pilot = min(candidates, key=lambda fit: fit.cost).x
    err = residual(pilot, 1.0)
    scales = np.r_[np.full(n, max(_mad(err[:n]), 1e-07)), np.full(len(y_rate), max(_mad(err[n:]), 1e-07))]
    fit = least_squares(residual, pilot, args=(scales,), bounds=(lower, upper), loss='cauchy', f_scale=2.5, x_scale='jac', max_nfev=200)
    (taus, theta) = (np.exp(fit.x[:2]), fit.x[2:].copy())
    order = np.argsort(taus)
    theta[:2] = theta[:2][order]
    return (taus[order], theta)

def solve_batch(dataset: dict) -> dict:
    """Fit material parameters on benchtop coupons and predict chamber response."""
    (train, test) = (dataset['train'], dataset['test'])
    (dt, times) = (dataset['past_dt'], dataset['eval_times'])
    (x_train, x_test) = _features(train, test)
    stress = _stress_map(dataset['calibration_load_cells'])
    (taus, theta) = _fit(train, x_train, stress, dt, times)
    (curves, rates) = _design(test, x_test, stress, dt, times, taus)
    curves[..., 2:] *= (-np.expm1(-times) / times)[None, :, None]
    return {'estimated_taus': taus, 'hereditary_weights': theta, 'predicted_strain': test['strain_0'][:, None] + curves @ theta, 'initial_rate_pred': rates @ theta}

def _predict_chamber(group, x, times, taus, theta):
    hold = np.sum(group['hold_channel_raw'], axis=-1)
    drift = theta[2] + x @ theta[3:]
    creep = 2.0 * times / (np.sqrt(1.0 + times) + 1.0)
    relaxation = -np.expm1(-times[:, None] / taus) @ theta[:2]
    strain = group['strain_0'][:, None] + hold[:, None] * relaxation + drift[:, None] * creep
    rate = hold * np.sum(theta[:2] / taus) + drift
    return (strain, rate)

def solve_downstream(cal_item: dict) -> dict:
    (train, test) = (cal_item['train'], cal_item['test'])
    (times, dt) = (cal_item['eval_times'], cal_item['past_dt'])
    (x_train, x_test) = _features(train, test)
    (taus, theta) = _fit(train, x_train, dt, times)
    (strain, rate) = _predict_chamber(test, x_test, times, taus, theta)
    return {'estimated_taus': taus, 'hereditary_weights': theta, 'predicted_strain': strain, 'initial_rate_pred': rate}
